related_questions.question: How to disinfect your house after COVID?

text_blocks.snippet: To disinfect your house after a COVID-19 case, prioritize cleaning surfaces with soap and water, then use a disinfectant on frequently touched surfaces. Ensure the disinfectant is effective against the virus and follow the instructions carefully.

list.title: 1. Cleaning:
list.snippet: Begin by cleaning surfaces with soap and water to remove dirt and debris. This is a crucial first step before disinfection.

Choose a disinfectant: Select a product that is effective against SARS-CoV-2, the virus that causes COVID-19, and follow the instructions on the label. According to the CDC, products on EPA's List N: Disinfectants for Coronavirus (COVID-19) are suitable.
Apply disinfectant: Follow the product's instructions for application, ensuring proper contact time for effective disinfection. Use gloves and consider wearing a mask for protection.

list.title: 3. Focus on frequently touched surfaces:
list.snippet: Prioritize disinfecting items and surfaces like doorknobs, light switches, countertops, tables, handles, toilets, phones, and remote controls.

list.title: 4. Ventilation:
list.snippet: Ensure proper ventilation during and after cleaning and disinfecting.

list.title: 5. Consider professional help:
list.snippet: If you're unsure or the situation is complex, consider engaging a professional cleaning service that specializes in COVID-19 disinfection.
